subject: N_eff and N_eff/s not agreeing or I'm not understanding.

messages.author: 9466f38039d48e25
messages.subject: N_eff and N_eff/s not agreeing or I'm not understanding.
parts: cmdstan's stansummary reports values for N_eff and N_eff/s that seem to conflict. For a single chain with 300 post-warmup iterations, N_eff for one parameter might be 300, but N_eff/s is "6.1e-02". I would have expected N_eff/s to be 1, in this case. Does N_eff/s mean something more complex than N_eff divided by the number of iterations? Are iterations and samples different? (I bet it's this last one, which means I don't understand something fundamental.) I do not see this covered in the cmdstan or Stan manuals.
